A.representative_generic_pattern: A disclosed structured value is absent or stale in active state.

B.representative_generic_pattern: Useful disclosed catalog text does not admit the target to any bounded generation pool.

C.representative_generic_pattern: The target is generated but loses eligibility or receives an unsupported contradiction/category treatment.

D.representative_generic_pattern: The target has higher disclosed-constraint coverage than at least one product above it.

E.representative_generic_pattern: Available dialogue evidence leaves the target coverage-tied with products above it.

F.representative_generic_pattern: A still-hidden catalog attribute is needed to distinguish the target and was not elicited.

G.representative_generic_pattern: Override evidence becomes usable only after the override turn.

H.representative_generic_pattern: Bounded traces do not establish a supported primary cause.
